head: 5 new lifestyle apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These lifestyle apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's paid Lifestyle chart this week, from a pocket typewriter for letters to a Christmas countdown and a private journal.
details: Post Club's holiday papers and greeting cards are included in the price. Open Chair Finder asks the next friend when someone can't make it and puts the game on your calendar. Santa's Christmas Countdown also has an Apple Watch app. Memoaday Pro adds more albums and iCloud sync as a monthly or yearly subscription.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store paid Lifestyle chart this week
means: If you want a small app for letters, game nights, the holidays or a daily photo, these are one-time purchases people in the US are buying right now; only Memoaday adds an optional subscription.
todo: Open each App Store page to check the price and what it needs before you buy: Memoaday's Pro features are a monthly or yearly subscription, and Santa's Christmas Countdown is in English only.

list.name: Post Club: Pocket Typewriter
list.what: A typewriter on your phone for writing letters, cards and notes with key sounds, then saving or sharing them.

list.name: Open Chair Finder
list.what: Asks your friends one by one, or all at once, to fill the missing spot in a game such as mahjong, bridge or pickleball.

list.name: Santa's Christmas Countdown
list.what: Counts down to Christmas Eve or Christmas Day over a painted North Pole village, with a Christmas tradition each day from 1 November to 6 January.

list.name: Memoaday: Quick Photo Calendar
list.what: A photo diary that puts one photo a day on a month calendar, for outfits, a growing child or a plant.

list.name: Senti: Private Journal
list.what: A journal that stays on your phone: type, speak, draw or add photos, with no account and no subscription.
